meta.name: antinet-four-color-cards
meta.description: 基于解析后的文档与用户意图，生成四色卡片——事实蓝卡、解释绿卡、风险黄卡、行动红卡，是八官署方法论的核心分析输出。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把文档内容拆成事实、解释、风险、行动四类卡片
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要在阅读资料后快速提炼出事实要点、潜在风险与可执行行动。
copy.tagline_en: Turn documents into fact, explanation, risk, and action cards
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to turn reading notes into facts, risks, and next steps.

howto.what: 把输入的结构化文档按用户意图拆成四色卡片：事实蓝卡、解释绿卡、风险黄卡、行动红卡；每张卡片都标注来源。若 LLM 不可用，自动降级为规则生成并在黄卡/红卡注明“未启用 LLM”。若缺来源，蓝卡标注“无来源”。
howto.when: 当用户提供已解析的结构化文档（markdown）并表达分析意图时触发；也适用于用户直接要求生成四色卡片或某类卡片（如风险卡）时。

say.text: 请根据这份调研报告生成四色卡片。
把这篇论文拆成事实卡和解释卡。
根据这份文档给我几条行动建议。

howto.what_en: Converts structured input into blue (fact), green (explanation), yellow (risk), and red (action) cards with sources. Falls back to rules when LLM is unavailable, marking yellow/red cards accordingly. Blue card flags missing sources.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a parsed structured document is provided along with an analysis intent, or when the user explicitly asks for four-color cards or a specific card type.

say_en.text: Generate four-color cards from this research report.
say_en.note: Outputs blue, green, yellow, red cards.

say_en.text: Break this paper into fact and explanation cards.
Give me action recommendations based on this document.
